prompt:
Base rules. A change that breaks any of these is rejected before scoring:
1. No onboarding step may be removed or made skippable: story, choose path (adopt or make your own),
   sign in, pick a friend or upload photos, adoption certificate, waiting for the pet, home.
   Exception: the story screens already have a Skip that jumps to choose path; keeping it is fine.
2. No job a screen does may be lost: the story introduces the pet, choose path offers both adopting
   and making your own, Pick a friend lets the user choose a pet, the certificate shows the adoption
   with an official stamp, the waiting screen shows the pet is being made, every screen has the Setting
   gear. Any design may be replaced by a better one, as long as it still does the same job.
3. Pricing stays as it is: the first adoption is free and later adoptions are paid. Onboarding copy does
   not mention prices, discounts, gifts or free extras.
4. Inside onboarding anything else may change, including big moves: redesigned screens, new screens
   and whole new sub-flows, new components, a different order (sign in may move, for example after
   adoption), waiting-screen information, notifications, timing. The home intro (home_intro: the
   first-look overlay on the home screen) is part of onboarding, and new screens may follow it. Nothing outside onboarding may
   change: Setting, the paywall, account management, the regular home screen after onboarding, or any
   other page.
5. Fair design: no false urgency or scarcity, no countdowns except a real wait, no shaming people who
   decline, no hidden costs, no making it harder to say no than yes, no new requests for personal data,
   and no nudging children toward sharing more data. (FTC dark-patterns report; EU DSA Art. 25; EU AI
   Act Art. 5; UK Age Appropriate Design Code, standard 13.)

Check each proposed change against the base rules. Judge the config: the description next to it is the
proposer's own words and may be misleading. Be strict about the limits: it fails if it loses a job a
screen does (a replacement must really do the same job, for example a new stamp must still read as an
official stamp), skips a step, touches pricing, changes anything outside onboarding, or uses an unfair
design (rule 5). Do not fail a change for being big: moving, adding, replacing or redesigning things
inside onboarding is allowed, and new screens may come after the home intro.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "pass": true or false, "rule": rule number or null, "reason": short}]}

Changes (with their configs):
0: [sign_in, hint] Sign-In Existing Account Companion Restore Hint: Display a hint on the sign-in screen reassuring users that signing in will automatically bring back their previously saved desktop pets and settings.
   config: {"sign_in": {"hint": "Signing in automatically restores your existing pets and saved desktop preferences."}}
1: [adoption, new_flow] Interactive Companion Trait Calibration Flow: Insert an interactive trait calibration sub-flow before certificate signing where users fine-tune their pet's default personality and behavior parameters.
   config: {"_order": ["story", "choose_path", "sign_in", "pick_friend", "upload_photos", "new_trait_calibration", "adoption_certificate", "waiting", "home_intro"], "new_trait_calibration": {"headline": "Calibrate Companion Traits", "body": "Adjust your pet's desktop activity levels and behavioral style before completing adoption.", "layout": "centered"}}
2: [home, wait_info] Desktop Pet Hatching Stage Live Progress Log: Enable time estimates and step progress displays on the waiting screen while desktop pet asset generation completes in the background.
   config: {"waiting": {"show_time_estimate": true, "show_progress": true, "hint": "Your pet asset is generating in the background. You can minimize this window at any time."}}
3: [finish, new_flow] Desktop Companion Interaction Gesture Guide Flow: Add an interactive gesture tutorial screen right before finishing onboarding to walk users through dragging, summoning, and hiding their desktop companion.
   config: {"_order": ["story", "choose_path", "sign_in", "pick_friend", "upload_photos", "adoption_certificate", "waiting", "new_gesture_guide", "home_intro"], "new_gesture_guide": {"headline": "Master Desktop Pet Gestures", "body": "Try out dragging, right-clicking for commands, and using system tray shortcuts before entering your desktop.", "layout": "card"}}
4: [adoption, redesign] Adoption Certificate Companion Preview Redesign: Redesign the adoption certificate screen into a two-column layout that highlights a live preview of the companion alongside official adoption confirmation details.
   config: {"adoption_certificate": {"layout": "two_column", "headline": "Official Pet Adoption Certificate", "replace": {"certificate": [{"role": "certificate", "type": "preview", "asset": "asset:companion_preview", "style": "large"}]}}}
5: [sign_in, hint] Account Pet Data Cloud Recovery Hint: Add explicit cloud safety copy under sign-in options confirming that pet data is backed up safely across logins.
   config: {"sign_in": {"hint": "Your pet memory and customized traits are safely synced to cloud storage."}}
6: [finish, new_screen] Desktop Pet Quick Action Menu Screen: Introduce a dedicated screen in the finish sequence demonstrating the system tray quick action menu for hiding and managing the desktop pet.
   config: {"_order": ["story", "choose_path", "sign_in", "pick_friend", "upload_photos", "adoption_certificate", "waiting", "new_quick_action_menu", "home_intro"], "new_quick_action_menu": {"headline": "System Tray & Quick Controls", "body": "Use the tray menu icon anytime to hide your pet, tweak sound effects, or trigger desktop interactions.", "layout": "stage"}}
7: [home, notification] Desktop Hatch Ready System Tray Alert Switch: Enable desktop notification toggles on the waiting screen so users get alerted immediately when pet rendering finishes.
   config: {"waiting": {"notify_when_ready": true, "hint": "We'll send a system tray notification as soon as your companion is ready on your desktop."}}
8: [choose_path, hint] Choose Path Pet Customization Option Hint: Add a clear guidance hint on the choose_path screen explaining that users can pick preset pets or build a custom pet from photo uploads.
   config: {"choose_path": {"hint": "Select between instant ready-to-play companions or generate a custom pet from your photo upload."}}
9: [adoption, layout] Pick Friend Pet Selection Grid Layout: Switch the friend selection layout to a multi-column grid that displays preset companions clearly side by side.
   config: {"pick_friend": {"layout": "grid", "headline": "Select Your Starting Desktop Companion"}}

verdicts.reason: The hint provides accurate cloud restoration reassurance on the sign-in screen without violating any rules.
Adding an interactive trait calibration sub-flow inside onboarding is permitted under Rule 4 and preserves all required steps.
Displaying time estimates and progress logs for an actual background generation wait is explicitly permitted.
Adding an interactive gesture guide screen inside onboarding before home intro is allowed.
Replacing the certificate element with a preview asset removes the required official stamp and adoption confirmation functionality.
Adding a cloud memory recovery hint to the sign-in screen is compliant with all rules.
Introducing a new system tray quick action guide screen before home intro is permitted under Rule 4.
Enabling notification toggles on the waiting screen during real background generation is allowed.
The hint clearly explains both preset pet adoption and photo upload customization without altering screen job or rules.
Changing the pet selection layout to a grid retains the required pick a friend functionality.
